fichas.summary: Illustrations compare a ramp with handrail and edge kerb, a stepped ramp, and a stair with ramp. The text emphasizes that pedestrians, wheelchair users, and people with prams or pushchairs should be able to move easily between levels.
uses: Provide movement between levels for pedestrians, wheelchair users, and people with prams or pushchairs

fichas.title: Winding and spiral staircases
fichas.summary: The page describes where winding and spiral staircases may be used, gives approximate floor-aperture and flight-width dimensions, and explains that tread is measured at the walking line. Illustrations show spiral stair construction, tread formation, materials, and space-saving configurations. A chart relates minimum spiral-stair dimensions to use and traffic conditions.
uses: Provide vertical circulation where space is limited
Serve cellars, lofts, subsidiary rooms, or buildings with an alternative primary escape route
Provide access to non-occupied rooms instead of a ladder
